sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 47 and Internal Quality Checks row 47
evidence: Judge agent+model are set once in task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] (REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"), byte-equal to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-71; all five judge.toml files carry only the allowed fallback judge = "claude-code" with no model/temperature/effort, and test.sh:63-66 refuses to grade without both env vars. tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (sha256 72998ab8...5fdd for both), and test.sh, scoring.toml, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py diff clean against the template. It pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (all confirmed to exist on npm/PyPI); the browser is pinned transitively because npm view shows @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 depends on exact playwright/playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05, whose bundled Chromium is installed into /opt/playwright-browsers and passed via --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium in every judge.toml. Graded time rules use the fixed clock: integration.md:7 states 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, seed_data.json clock equals it, app_context.md:29 repeats it, and the time-based criteria (functional judge.toml:127 boundary-at-exactly-seven-days with a one-second-younger control, :139 nine-day-old edited JUDGE-TE, :257-258 transcript generated time vs. stored sent times) are all expressed relative to seeded timestamps and that clock, never the run date; the golden derives time only from seed.clock (server.js:32-33,143,418,439,517). Counterexample attempts: an app that uses Date.now() for timers would, on any real run date (Oct 2026+), erase the one-second-younger control and nearly every seeded message, so functional:127 fails it; an app that uses the fixed clock correctly is graded identically regardless of when the verifier runs, so no conforming alternative is penalised by run date. Notes (not defects, template-controlled per AGENTS.md): base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) not digest-pinned and apt packages are unversioned; LLM judge sampling is inherently stochastic and temperature is explicitly not required by the client row; open verifier network is explicitly not a defect. No full configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), but this row's pinning/clock properties are statically verifiable and were verified.
